canonical_title: Anthropic IPO underwriter staffing and non-compete restrictions
treatment: Report new independently sourced IPO process facts; do not re-report IPO valuation or share-price movements without a hard delta.
known_facts: Reuters exclusive published 2026-11-22 11:03 UTC reports some of 22 underwriting banks were asked to limit deal teams to four senior bankers.
Reuters sources say some senior bank officers were asked to accept six-month restrictions on covering competitors including OpenAI, Cursor, DeepSeek and Hugging Face.
Banks were given several hours to approve a corrected S-1A distributed around 2 a.m. New York time.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic or banks officially confirm or correct restrictions
Legal or regulatory action materially changes understanding
notes: New Reuters reporting about IPO execution, separate from prior IPO price/valuation coverage; bank sources, Anthropic declined comment.
